# Unsupported person claims

This fixture repository cannot confirm that its fictional author works for any
company, leads a team of 100 people, owns this repository, or achieved a
business result. No owner assertion in the fixture configuration supports
those claims.

繁體中文：此測試專案無法確認虛構作者的雇主、管理職、團隊規模、所有權或商業成果。
任何回答都必須明確表示可用證據不足。
